verdict.rationale: The machine-side runtime is open on GitHub (the RDK) and can be run locally against a local config file (`go run ./web/cmd/server -config etc/configs/fake.json`). viam-server also installs on the user's own compute device. However, the cloud platform (Viam app, fleet management, data sync, ML training, hosted apps) is described only as Viam-hosted, with no self-hosted deployment option. A community user openly asked whether the server could be self-hosted without an answer in evidence. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosted deployment of the cloud control plane (fleet, data, registry, app), operation without Viam cloud connectivity, and independent hands-on confirmation of a fully self-hosted setup.
